'''Machine-lifters''' were large, [[wheel]]ed devices equipped with an arm for lifting equipment. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] once used a machine-lifter to break down the door of a garage in which [[Kea Moll]] was working after a gas leak caused her to lose consciousness.
